name: contact-strip
description: Compact labelled contact rows with optional icons and links.
designIntent: Marketing footers and contact sections repeat phone, email and address rows. ContactStrip keeps the label/value pairing consistent and gives phone and email links the right destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Contact rows: label, value, optional href and icon.

examples.title: Contact details
examples.code:
<ContactStrip
  items={[
    { label: 'Call', value: '1.800.860.4519', href: 'tel:18008604519' },
    { label: 'Email', value: 'info@axial.net', href: 'mailto:info@axial.net' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Phone and email rows with links.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a bare URL as the label
antiPatterns.explanation: The label should name the channel (Call, Email, Address), not repeat the value.

accessibility.implementation: Renders ul/li with a label and a value per row
Phone uses tel: and email uses mailto: when provided

compositionRules.relationship: Place ContactStrip in the footer contact column

files.content:
